mint-move-and-burn.text: Insert certification mints an action token. Folding Insert mints the representative. Application changes move it. Terminal requests hold it, then folding burns it. Withdraw cancels only a pending Insert.

insert-certify-first-check-absence-when-.text: The application approves the exact initial state and destination before folding. The request does not reserve the key. Singular checks absence and creates the certified output when folding succeeds.

application-evolution-keep-the-same-repr.text: The application validator can move its existing NFT to a successor state without changing the registry.

update-and-delete-transfer-authority-int.text: The application authorizes transfer into the exact request. Its NFT stays there until completion. Update permanently retires the key. Delete permits reuse.

what-batching-establishes.text: Requests apply to successive map states. Certificate disposal may still invoke the application minting policy. No performance result or universal application coverage is claimed.
